body.message:
Kindly be informed that we are a holiday home rental company operating through Airbnb and therefore do not provide hotel-style services. However, the building reception is available 24/7 and can promptly coordinate with the relevant team whenever assistance is required.

We would like to assure you that we are happy to arrange a relocation if necessary. The delay was due to the time needed to identify a suitable vacant unit within the same area. Additionally, the building maintenance team has confirmed that they have already completed an inspection inside the apartment.
